canonical_identity.title: Mundari: The myth of a language without word classes
canonical_identity.repository: Australian National University Open Research Repository

canonicalization.rule: DOI, ANU repository record, publisher manifestation, citations and downloadable repository PDF are manifestations of one article identity
canonicalization.dependency_note: The article explicitly analyses Hoffmann material plus new data; propositions derived from overlapping Hoffmann material must not be counted as independent corroboration without passage-level dependency review.

rights_access_governance.note: Open-access availability is not treated as a reusable-content licence, participant consent, or cultural permission.

remaining_gates: obtain lawful immutable PDF bytes if permitted
extract only supported exact passages with locators
trace Hoffmann-versus-new-data dependency for any promoted proposition
review participant and cultural-access implications for newly elicited data
count_policy: Do not alter controlled MMSC totals until deterministic reconciliation against the WEB-MUN ledger.
